F-duck-drive-0144.name: Unnamed wetland by Dewar Creek
F-duck-drive-0144.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).

evidence.t: Unnamed wetland, 2.0 ha, 180 m from the road.
Beside Dewar Creek: backwater or oxbow (estimate).

flags.t: CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-20: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: District 4. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.
